workflow.title: Email Liz the tasks currently marked done
workflow.goal: Read the tracker, keep only items with status done, project them to title and status, and email the short list to liz@beaconcontent.co, then independently confirm the message reached the outbox. The tracker has no completion dates, so the list is all items currently done, not only those finished last week.

assumptions: Recipient is liz@beaconcontent.co, as the person specified.
The person accepted a sensible default, so the list covers all items currently marked done.
The person chose the simple format: one line per done item.
risks: The tracker has no completion date, so the email cannot be limited to last week and may repeat items reported in earlier weeks.
The capabilities have no scheduler, so Monday-morning timing must be set up outside this flow.
outbox.send asks a person before each dispatch when run live.
successCriteria: The email lists only tracker items with status done.
The email is delivered to liz@beaconcontent.co and the outbox audit passes.

nodes.description: Read all work items from the tracker sheet.
Keep only items whose status is done.
Keep only the title and status fields so the tally accepts the rows.
Build the list of done item titles.
Fill the email body with the done list.
Email the done list to Liz.
Re-read the outbox to confirm the email was delivered to Liz with the saved hash.

outbox.subject: Tasks currently marked done
